## Jack Allen’s Kitchen

Since 2009, Jack Allen’s Kitchen has operated with a Lone Star state of mind, serving up southern comfort food with a Texas twist and warm hospitality to the Austin area. We
believe in supporting our neighbors, respect for the land, and honoring Texas’ many cultures and best ingredients.

[ABOUT US](https://www.jackallenskitchen.com/our-story/ "ABOUT US ")

## Oak Hill

Oak Hill offers two private dining rooms, the Oak Room and the Creek Room, and can be combined.

* Creek Room: Seats 18 guests
* Oak Room: Seats 28 Guests
* Combined: Seats up to 48 guests

## Hutto

Our Hutto location offers 1 large private banquet room with large windows overlooking the water and seating for up to 50 guests. We offer a large TV with connections for photo slideshows or business presentations. Dedicated servers are there to assist in setup and are there to take care of anything you or your guests might need.

[Menu & Pricing Info](https://jackallenskitchen.com/wp-content/uploads/Banquet-Brochure-Hutto.pdf "Menu & Pricing Info")

## Anderson Lane

At our Anderson Lane location, we’ve got you covered, literally. Our private back patio seats up to 45 guests and overlooks Shoal Creek. With garage doors that can be opened or closed, the patio is enjoyable year-round.

[Menu & Pricing Info](https://jackallenskitchen.com/wp-content/uploads/1-Banquet-Brochure-JAKAL.pdf "Menu & Pricing Info")

OUR STORY

# Dine Friendly, The Texas Way

Proud To Be Texan

###

We work with local artists, farmers, ranchers, winemakers, distillers, brewers and coffee roasters, and highlight the artisans of Texas and Austin whenever possible. We’re fortunate to live in a town and a state that produces quality products—from the art on the wall to the food on the plate to the spirits in your glass.

SOUTHERN

south

Southern Comfort Food With A Texas Twist

## Texas’ many cultures and best ingredients serve as daily inspiration.

Warm Hospitality &

## A Lone Star State Of Mind

With a warm and welcoming atmosphere, you’re encouraged to kick back and stay awhile. Everyone on our hard-working team has abundant culinary knowledge and always serves up the best experience around to make your meal memorable. We don’t need to be the best restaurant but we’ll never stop trying to be your favorite.

[Image: Fully Reserved Jack Allen's Kitchen Restaurant - People Dining]

[Image: Happy Customers in Jack Allen's Kitchen Talking While Having a Dinner Together]

[Image: Delicious Food Served in Jack Allen's Kitchen 360 Location - Salads and Chips]

Here To Help

## Part Of The Community

Cultivating a healthy community through charity and comforting food is our mantra and part of our culture. Our team could not do what we do without the help of our local farmers, brewers, ranchers and more. Whenever there is an opportunity to give back, big or small, our team is there to help those in need and pay homage to the folks that make Texas so damn tasty.

[DONATIONS](https://www.jackallenskitchen.com/donations/ "DONATIONS")

# Bringing people together and honoring our land is why we’re here

We’re Always

## Here To Help

Jack Allen’s Kitchen was co-founded by Jack Gilmore and Tom Kamm, who share the belief that good food brings people of all walks of life together. Cultivating a healthy community through charity and comforting food is part of our culture. Our team could not do what we do without the help of our local farmers, ranchers, brewers and more. And we will always help them out, no matter how big or small.

To apply for a donation, please complete our donation request form below. Please allow 7–10 business days for a response from the Jack Allen’s Kitchen team.

We ask that donation requests be submitted at least one month in advance of your event.
